contexts.text: (Refreshment by an alternate state of peace during temptations.)
The state of first illustration, and the recreation therefrom.
Their consolation, refreshment, and instruction after desolation. Treated of.
Refreshment and instruction in truths. Signified.

The foods of the Angels are the goods of love and of charity, by which they are not only vivified, but also recreated. These goods in act... are especially for their recreation; for... desires, when obtained in act, afford recreation and life.
Meat to refresh the soul ().
Recreation from the internal. Signified, Explained.
The Lord is present with those in temptation, and resists... whence come refreshment, hope, and victory.
The delight of smell is less, because it serves only for recreation, and thus for health.
A defect of truth, and thence of refreshment. Signified, Explained.
For as water and drink refresh the natural life, so do truths and the Knowledges of truth refresh the spiritual life... AC 8584.
Idleness of one's life is only for the sake of recreation...
Uses to sustain the body relate to its... recreation, etc.
Recreation and delectation (as applied to the soul) are the happiness of life, and heavenly joy.
From the love of self and the world, man wants... to be delighted and recreated by the delights of the world.
Social gatherings (there) exhilarate minds... delight bosoms, and recreate bodies.
Heavenly peace... may be compared to recreations of the lower mind.
Social gatherings in the Primitive Church were recreations of souls after studies and labours.
To glorify the Lord is not use; but is recreation.
Fear not = recreation.

If the Lord's presence is excessive, it causes anguish; but recreation by accommodation and reception... (This) recreation, when presented to view there, appears as a cloud. With such a cloud are all the Societies veiled, denser or thinner according to the reception.
Interruptions of works in company with others are recreations, and thus are uses. AE 1226:2.
That lower minds are revived, recreated, and excited... by the odours and savours of plants, is known.
That there are diversions of charity, which are various delights and pleasantnesses of the bodily senses, useful to refresh the lower mind. General article.
